card.title: JUNKERS JU 88 A
card.flavorText: The Junkers Ju 88 was a German twin-engine multi-role combat aircraft used in WWII by the Luftwaffe and the Axis powers. Many variants of the aircraft were produced and it served as a bomber, dive bomber, night fighter, torpedo bomber, reconnaissance aircraft, heavy fighter, and as a flying bomb by the end of the war. Due to its multiple roles, the Ju 88 became one of the most important aircraft for the Luftwaffe and it was produced nonstop from 1936 to 1945.
